product: Logitech G headsets (HID++ 2.0, and the PRO X 2 LIGHTSPEED and G522 LIGHTSPEED over Centurion)
models: G522 LIGHTSPEED (dongle 0B18, USB cable 0B19; battery only)
works: written from Solaar (e7304c4c) and HeadsetControl (91ee690a) and checked against simulated headsets only (tests/sim-logitech-headset.mjs)
feature lookup through Root getFeature (no fixed indexes), on the dongle and, for the PRO X 2, through its Centurion bridge
battery: 0x1004 / 0x1000, else 0x1F20 (millivolts, Solaar's voltage curve, charging flag); PRO X 2: 0x0104 percent and charging
sidetone: 0x8300 read fn 0x00 / write fn 0x10, 0-100 (Solaar Sidetone); PRO X 2: 0x0604 read 0x00 / write 0x10 in the headset's own gain steps (Solaar HeadsetSidetone)

turn off when idle: 0x1F20 v2+ read 0x10 / write 0x20, 0-255 min (Solaar ADCPower), the G535 limited to HeadsetControl's 0 / 1 / 2 / 5 / 10 / 15 / 30; PRO X 2: 0x0108 read 0x00 / write 0x10, the other timer slots sent back as read (Solaar HeadsetAutoSleep)
mic muted, shown only: 0x0601 read fn 0x10 (Solaar HeadsetMicMute)
EQ per band where the headset has 0x8310: range and band frequencies from the headset, read fn 0x20 [00], write fn 0x30 [02, gains] with every other band sent back as read (Solaar Equalizer)
every write read back; every write refused while G HUB (lghub*.exe) runs

23 Oct 2026: the G522 LIGHTSPEED, battery only (read-only): Centurion frames with report 0x50 and the address byte 0x23 (HeadsetControl logitech_g522_lightspeed.hpp @ a8120a62: id 0x0b18, usage page 0xFFA0 usage 0x0001 interface 3, FRAME_PREFIX 50 23; Solaar base.py @ e7304c4c: the 0x50 variant, "typical G522 (addr=0x23)", the address taken from a received frame; descriptors.py: 0x0B18 dongle, 0x0B19 wired); battery 0x0104 fn 0x00 through the bridge (HC getBattery), b0 percent, b2 1 / 2 charging, 3 full (Solaar centurion.py); the cable 0B19 on the 0xFFA0 collection with 63-byte reports (Solaar udev_impl.py), asked directly when it has no bridge (Solaar centurion.py). No address is ever guessed: only 0x23, or one the headset sent a frame from
doesNotWork: firmware updates, DFU, resets and pairing (never: Logitech's own app only)
setting the mic mute (only shown; the headset's own button mutes)
EQ on the PRO X 2 (0x020D / 0x0636: no plain read of the same value documented)

G431 / G432 / G433 (0A9B / 0A9C / 0A6D, HeadsetControl logitech_g432.hpp @ a8120a62): not run. HeadsetControl only writes their sidetone (05 1E level) with no reply read, on no named HID collection; no battery; Solaar and libratbag do not list them, so there is nothing to read back or show
G533 sidetone (HeadsetControl writes it with fixed bytes and no read)

G522 sidetone, auto sleep, lights, EQ, voice prompts and mic-mute light: not offered yet (HeadsetControl has a sidetone read 0x0604 fn 0x00 and auto-sleep read 0x0108 fn 0x00 for it; lights, EQ and voice prompts are write-only there); the G522 over Bluetooth
G435 and ASTRO A50 X (in neither project), ASTRO A50 Gen 4 / 5 (their own protocol)
